prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D game sprite atlas, four independent RIGHT hands gripping a wooden hammer shaft; 2x2 grid. Input image 1 is a grip/anatomy concept reference ONLY; input image 2 is the authoritative knight art style/material/proportion reference.
Create a NEW compact grip-hand atlas. Top left: near-side knight right hand; top right: same anatomical right hand from the opposite/palm-visible camera side. Bottom left and bottom right: civilian trainer matching near/far leather hands with no armor. All four WRISTS/CUFFS extend to image RIGHT. The brown wooden shaft runs DIAGONALLY from UPPER LEFT through the PALM to LOWER RIGHT, at approximately 45 degrees, never vertically. The upper-left end is the hammer-head end. Show only a short shaft protrusion above the thumb and below the fingers, NO hammer head. The thumb wraps around the shaft and the fingers clearly curl around its front/below; avoid a shaft emerging through flat front knuckles.
The knight wears the SAME simple BROWN LEATHER glove visible on the free hand of reference 2, with a very short silver-blue wrist brace at its right edge, not silver metal fingers. The trainer glove is warm brown leather without blue or steel. Hands are CHUNKY and COMPACT: palm/fist is broad; distance from shaft center to wrist opening should be around 0.7 times palm height. No long flaring cuffs, no elongated clenched fist. This compact angled grip must allow the forearm to approach behind the wrist without bending it backwards during a downward hammer stroke.
Style must match reference 2: softly painted children's game art, rounded leather volumes, muted shaded silver-blue cuff only, gentle warm highlights, restrained contrast, fine colored contour instead of thick black ink. Do not imitate the hyper-shiny, hard outlined metal fingers of reference 1. Four complete separated sprites, equal size and orientation, generous transparent gutters and margins, flat consistent camera, no labels, no extra items, no watermark. True transparent background, preserve fully opaque hand centers.
